title: Private-Fleet Quarterly Quilt: tranche mapping, OKR stitching and compliance windows
creator: Asha Patel
description: Quarter plan to sequence private/VPC/on-prem features into tranche-based sprints that align to OKRs for Q2. Deliverables: tranche map, failure-budget allocation, compliance gating matrix (KMS, audit-logs, SSO), migration window calendar, and runbook for roll-forward/rollback. This ticket synthesizes cross-functional inputs (Eng, Security, Console, Sales) and produces a prioritized activation plan for 6 initial enterprise customers earmarked for the private-fleet pilot.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A tranche map that groups pilot customers by risk and technical posture with clear activation windows; 2) OKR mapping table linking each tranche to measurable success metrics (latency SLOs, per-token cost delta, onboarding time); 3) Failure budget and rollback thresholds documented and agreed with Eng/SRE; 4) Compliance gating matrix validated by Security (KMS, HSM, audit retention), and an approved patch/upgrade cadence for private instances; 5) Runbook and on-call rotation set for first 30 days post-activation; 6) Stakeholder sign-off from Sales, Customer Success, Security, and Platform PMs.
updates: 2026-02-20: Created. Kickoff meeting scheduled with Eng, Security, Console, and Solutions on 2026-02-24 to align constraints and initial customer cohort.

2026-02-24: Kickoff held. Engineering requested clearer compatibility matrix (OSS models, quantization) per customer. Security flagged KMS integrations for two customers as non-standard — needs design doc.
2026-03-02: Draft tranche map completed; assigned preliminary risk scores (network complexity, data residency, infra maturity). Identified 6 pilot customers and 3 fallback cohorts.
2026-03-05: PM/Product Review — agreed on failure budget targets: <5% availability degradation impact window per tranche and token-cost regression <10% relative to hosted baseline.

2026-03-09: Engineering provided implementation constraints: dedicated autoscaling lanes must be provisioned 2 weeks prior to tranche activation; KV cache warm-up script required for low-latency SLA attainment.
2026-03-12: Security review checklist drafted. Action: Security to validate KMS/HSM key import flows by 2026-03-19. Next milestone: stakeholder sign-off meeting 2026-03-22.
Pending: Design doc for non-standard KMS flows (owner: Security), Console dashboard slice for tranche telemetry (owner: Console Eng), and customer onboarding checklist (owner: Solutions).
Risks noted: overlapping customer cutovers in the same region could breach capacity SLOs; mitigation: add regional capacity hedges and optionally delay tranche by 1 sprint.
notes: Decision: prioritize customers with existing KMS compatibility to reduce early security gating work.
Trade-off: pushing the most complex customers to tranche 3 increases cadence risk but keeps initial slowness contained to lower-risk cohorts.
Follow-up: prepare 'failure budget drill' tabletop exercise with SRE and Solutions one week before tranche activation.
